hypothesis: A QQQ-SPY opening-half-hour residual standardized against the previous 60 complete opening windows predicts same-day reversion; evaluate QQQ-long for negative residual and SPY-long for positive residual separately.
selection_status: Fixed before computing this specification. Reuses repeatedly inspected M2/H3 histories: development only. No threshold or lookback sweep.
capital_interpretation: Each symbol, period, rule and cost case is an alternative $2000 cash-account simulation, never summed into a portfolio. Reset each period.
price_adjustment: Actual unadjusted ETF bars. All model inputs are within-session open-to-10:00 log returns, so overnight splits/dividends do not mechanically create cross-day returns. Intraday corporate-action history and NBBO are not verified; no market-neutral execution claim.
reserved: Do not calculate October 2026 performance. The nine-month 2026 period is not annualized into an achieved annual return. Future paper evidence remains necessary.
data_inspection_disclosure: All 2025 and 2026 Jan-Sep histories were previously inspected for M2/H3. There is no untouched performance holdout in this run.

data_provenance.snapshot_format: connector-exported CSV, with request metadata and SHA-256 manifest; not raw HTTP responses or proof of source truth
data_provenance.access_limitations: 2023 SPY bars, 2025 SPY historical quotes, Benzinga earnings and NES quotes returned NOT_ENTITLED. 2025 SPY minute bars and NES contract metadata were accessible. An initial NES launch-day bar probe was empty.
data_provenance.execution_evidence: Aggregate traded prices only. No NBBO, queue depth, individual fills or point-in-time receipt timestamps. Assumed fills are a price screen, not execution replay.

strategy.opening_range: maximum high minus minimum low of these three completed bars
strategy.signal: External frozen I037 active-date set; engine clock rule supplies only current-day opening-low stop.
strategy.clock_benchmark: All model-eligible days; additionally previous-eligible-day signal on the same asset, same entry/exit/stop/sizing rules. Trade counts and volatility are not exactly matched.
strategy.entry: 10:05 observed open, five minutes after first half-hour closes; skip if entry <= own first-half-hour low.
strategy.stop: Own first-half-hour low; completed close trigger and an extra five-minute delay, inherited from M2.
strategy.timed_exit: 15:50 regular-session bar open, or next available regular-session open. An unclosed position at session end is an experiment error, never silently dropped.
strategy.risk_exit: A drawdown pause observed at a bar open schedules liquidation at least five minutes later; a close observation schedules at bar-start + 10 minutes. Low prices are retrospective diagnostics and do not trigger trades before they are observable.
strategy.position_sizing: Floor minimum of planned stop-risk quantity (including assumed entry/exit friction and two order fees), 95% marked-equity quantity, and settled cash less overhead reserve and entry fee. Cannot force a minimum share.

settlement.model: Conservative T+1 cash availability: sale proceeds unavailable until the next weekday that is neither a listed exchange closure nor a listed bank-only holiday. Settled cash may fund a new trade; unsettled proceeds may not.
settlement.limitation: This deliberately conservative union calendar is not asserted to reproduce all DTC limited settlement services or broker-specific fund availability.

calendar.missing_data: Validate each expected full trading session exists. Do not forward-fill bars. Missing input bars skip the signal; missing exact entry expires it. Missing holding bars reduce risk visibility; an open position with no later exit bar is an error. Never discard a session because of a later missing bar.

cost_disclosure: 5/10 bps per side jointly proxy spread and slippage; $0.02/$0.04 per order proxy cash trading charges. These and $10/month overhead are assumptions, not verified historical broker fees or guaranteed executable quotes. Monthly overhead continues during a pause. Actual ETF prices embed fund performance; do not separately subtract an expense ratio.
primary_metric: Net account return under costs, versus same-asset same-clock previous-eligible-day-signal and clock-only controls; gross future residual is separately descriptive, never booked as cash PnL.
rejection_rules: For a side to advance even to further research: positive base-cost returns and beat both same-asset controls in BOTH windows; positive double-variable-cost returns in BOTH windows; no observed 40% drawdown breach.
Mean oriented timed residual must be positive in BOTH windows; this is only a price diagnostic, not a hedge or a statistical proof.
Any survivor still requires independent data, sector/rate-factor controls, quotes and forward validation. Reject this fixed rule on failure; do not optimize thresholds on these outcomes.
Report all 36 account scenarios and two period diagnostics, including errors. Accounts are alternatives and returns must not be added.
2025 alone is a full calendar year target check including warmup and overhead; never annualize 2026 Jan-Sep to a realized annual result.

relative_model.regression: OLS intercept plus slope on previous 60 synchronized opening returns only
relative_model.warmup: No trading before 60 previous complete opening windows. 2026 uses past 2025 model history, but resets account equity. No overnight return enters regression.
relative_model.eligibility: Expected non-early-close sessions, all six opening bars available for both assets, positive beta and nonzero x variance / residual variance. No eligibility test on future holding-window data.
relative_model.invalid_fit: Skip signals; retain reason. Missing expected full session remains an engine error.
relative_model.lagged_control: On an eligible session use the candidate flag from the immediately previous eligible session. No future matching or best-date choice. First eligible session has no lagged flag.
relative_model.data_quality: Fail the run for duplicate/invalid OHLC, unmatched full-session timestamps or >20% adjacent within-session open-vs-previous-close discontinuity. This is a whole-dataset integrity gate, not selective deletion of losing dates.
relative_model.diagnostic: For each candidate event calculate timed 10:05-to-15:50 log QQQ return minus that day ex-ante beta times SPY return, orient against opening residual. Ignores stops/costs/sizing; not executable PnL. Report count/mean/median and all daily rows; no significance claim.
